The '''Ryoone system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryoone/Legends|Ryoone]], homeworld of the [[Lyunesi]] and five other sentient species.
